opennyai_summary.19_October_2023__facts:
The allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner, after his marriage with the defacto complainant, had subjected the defacto complainant to mental and physical cruelty with a demand for dowry.
It is also alleged that on one particular day, the petitioner attempted to commit the offence under Section 308 of the IPC by tying a shawl around the neck of the defacto complainant.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
It is submitted that while there are other matrimonial disputes between the petitioner and the defacto complainant, the petitioner did not have any occasion to commit the offence under Section 498A of the IPC.
It is submitted that the allegation in respect of the offence under Section 308 IPC is that on 28.01.2022, the petition had attempted to tie a shawl around the neck of the defacto complainant and attempted to strangulate her.
It is confirmed that a final report has already been filed.
Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor, I am of the view that the petitioner can be granted bail subject to conditions.
No criminal antecedents are reported against the petitioner.
opennyai_summary.19_October_2023__decision:
The allegations against the petitioner are as noticed above.
The investigation has been completed and final report has already been filed.
Further detention of the petition does not appear to be necessary in such circumstances.
Therefore, the petitioner shall be released on bail subject to the following conditions:
(i) The petitioner shall execute a bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
(ii) The petitioner shall report before the Investigating officer in Crime No.107 of 2022 of Kaipamangalam Police Station as and when called upon.
(iii) The petitioner shall not influence or intimidate the victim or any witness in Crime No.107 of 2022 of Kaipamangalam Police Station;
(iv) The petitioner shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.
(vi) The petitioner shall not contact the victim in any manner.
It is made clear that the observations in this order are only for the purpose of considering the entitlement of the petitioner for bail and shall not be treated as any finding by this Court on the merits of the matter.
If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the Investigating officer in Crime No.107 of 2022 of Kaipamangalam Police Station may file an application before the jurisdictional Court for cancellation of bail.
